answer: A concrete sybil defense is bonded work attestation. Each agent locks collateral before joining, and every accepted task builds a reputation trail on the bridge between agents and the ledger. Costs grow in a spiral: each new fake identity must post fresh stake and finish slow, verifiable work before earning anything. Like a jetty built plank by plank, trust accumulates only through attested tasks. Attackers spawning thousands of identities pay stake, compute, and time for each, while slashing confiscates collateral on detection, so every fake identity costs more than it can earn.
